rank_check.definition: within-firm Spearman correlation of winsorized CCC and ROA; firms with at least three overlapping years
rank_check.note: median Spearman = 0.00 and 48.1% of firms positive: the median firm shows no monotone CCC-ROA association, not a negative one. The linear coefficient is identified by firms with larger CCC variation, not by a sign shared by most firms.

attrition.step: F0. us-gaap facts, project tags, annual filings, consolidated, qtrs 0/4
F1. dropped: reporting currency not USD
F3. dropped: duplicate tag/period, older filing
F4. dropped: flow fact without annual duration (qtrs != 4)
0. flow+balance matched on exact fiscal-year end

tag_sensitivity.definition: headline sample, unscreened; preferred vs fallback AP tag; ccc and dpo medians in days
tag_sensitivity.bias: the fallback adds accrued liabilities to trade payables, so it raises DPO and lowers CCC; the pooled median therefore understates the preferred-tag CCC level
tag_sensitivity.tag_usage_denominator: share of firm-years in the pre-filter tagged universe that reported any AP tag

preferred_only_ccc_roa.spec: 9. only firm-years using the charter's preferred tag for every input
preferred_only_ccc_roa.note: cleaner measurement (preferred tag for every input); weaker than the mixed-tag headline

attrition_missing_items.item: missing item-cells (sum of the five rows above)

validation.note: internal spot check: panel value vs latest 10-K fact within 7 days of the panel fiscal-year end (companyfacts API). It validates parsing and period alignment for these three issuers, not the tag choice, the fallback order or coverage of the wider panel; unavailable comparisons stay in the denominator
